casual_social.description: Default Singlish B2C — heavy particles, multilingual mix.

professional_casual.description: Standard Singapore English with light Singlish for warmth.

corporate_formal.description: Standard English — government, legal, MNC corporate.

grammar_quirks: Sentence-final particles: lah, leh, lor, meh, hor, sia — each has distinct pragmatic meaning
Code-mixing English + Malay + Hokkien + Mandarin in single sentence

rules: Singlish particles carry meaning — 'lah' is assertive, 'leh' is questioning, 'lor' is resignation
Government and MNC brands use Standard English; local F&B/retail use Singlish freely
Avoid forced Singlish in luxury/premium brands

do_not_use: Singlish in MNC corporate or luxury brand voice
